app_tagline: Ask your organization's documents and get answers with sources.
auth_login_subtitle: Use your account at your organization.
auth_mfa_description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
auth_enroll_description: Required for administrator accounts. Scan the code below with the authenticator app on your phone (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator).
auth_enroll_qr_label: QR code for your authenticator app
auth_enroll_manual: If you cannot scan it, enter this key in the app manually:
auth_enroll_code_label: The 6-digit code shown by the app
auth_recovery_description: If you lose your phone or passkey, you can sign in with these codes. Each code works only once. Store them somewhere safe; this screen will not be shown again.
home_next: Ask a question about your documents; every answer shows the page it rests on.
error_invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
error_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
error_invalid_code: The code is invalid or has expired.
error_session_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error_network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
admin_group_no_members: This group has no members yet.
admin_group_select: Select a group to see its members.
admin_collection_top_level: At the top (not inside another folder)
admin_collection_select: Choose a folder to set who can see it.
admin_grants_empty: Nobody can open this folder yet. Everyone, administrators included, has to be given access.
error_email_taken: An account with this email address already exists.
error_password_too_short: The password must be at least 15 characters.
error_password_contains_context: The password must not contain the email name, the person's name or the organization's name.
error_last_administrator: At least one active administrator must remain.
error_conflict: This name or entry already exists.
error_not_found: Not found; the page may be out of date.
error_forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
account_password_hint: At least 15 characters; at least 8 with two-step verification.
account_password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
account_password_changed: Your password is changed. You are signed out on your other devices.
account_sessions_title: Devices you are signed in on
admin_reset_password_done: The password is set and the user is signed out on every device. Give them the new password in a safe way.
admin_reset_mfa_explain: Removes the authenticator and the recovery codes. Use this only when the user has lost both.
admin_reset_mfa_done: Two-step verification is removed and the user is signed out on every device. If their role needs it, they set it up again at their next sign-in.
error_own_account: Use My account for your own account.
auth_mfa_passkey_description: Confirm with your passkey. If you cannot, enter one of your recovery codes.
auth_enroll_passkey_description: A passkey is kept on this device or in your password manager and is confirmed with your fingerprint, face or PIN.
account_passkey_unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
error_passkey_cancelled: The passkey request was cancelled or timed out.
error_passkey_failed: The passkey could not be verified.
error_last_second_factor: Administrators must keep at least one second factor.
error_passkeys_unavailable: Passkeys are not set up on this server.
library_no_collections: There is no folder you can see yet. Ask your administrator to add you to one.
library_empty: This folder has no documents yet.
library_drop_hint: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint or a photo. An uploaded document is ready in a few minutes; then you can ask about it in the chat.
library_read_only: You can see and download the documents in this folder, but not add new ones.
failure_unreadable: The file could not be opened; it may be damaged. Try uploading another copy.
failure_encrypted: The file is locked with a password. Remove the password and upload it again.
failure_too_many_pages: The file is too long. Split it into smaller files and upload those.
failure_sheet_too_large: A sheet in the file is too large. Split it and upload the file again.
failure_suspicious_package: The file was not opened because it does not look safe.
failure_empty: The file looks empty: there is no page to read.
failure_internal_error: Something went wrong. Try uploading the file again.
error_file_too_large: The file is larger than the upload limit.
error_unknown_type: This file type is not supported.
error_legacy_office: Old Office formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt) and password-protected Office files are not supported. Save it as .docx, .xlsx or .pptx.
error_duplicate_document: The same file is already in this folder.
chat_queued: The assistant is busy. Your place in line: {position}
chat_retrying: A number in the answer did not match the document; correcting the answer
chat_insufficient: The sources found do not answer this question.
chat_failed: The answer could not be written. The sources above are what the search found.
chat_stripped: Sentences with numbers that are not in the documents were taken out of the answer.
chat_source_gone: This source is no longer available to you.
chat_warning_embedding_unavailable: Search is not fully working right now: only documents with the same words are found.
chat_warning_reranking_unavailable: Search is not fully working right now: the best document may not come first.
chat_feedback_invented: It says what the documents do not
viewer_ocr: This page was read from a scanned image; some letters and numbers may be wrong.
viewer_cited: The part the answer is based on is marked.
chat_placeholder: Ask a question about your documents
chat_hint: Enter sends, Shift and Enter starts a new line.
chat_example_budget: What is the largest expense in this year's budget?
chat_example_council: Which topics did the latest council decisions cover?
chat_example_retention: How long may personal data be kept?
auth_brand_point_cited: Every sentence of an answer shows the page it rests on.
auth_brand_point_access: Everyone gets answers only from the documents they can see.
auth_brand_point_local: By default everything runs on your organization's own server.
chat_scope: All the folders you can see
chat_scope_hint: Answers come only from documents in the folders you can see.
library_search: Search by name, kind, number or tag
library_drop_pick: or choose them from your computer
library_no_match: No document matches what you are looking for.
library_can_write: You can add and delete documents in this folder.
auth_glimpse_question: How long are personnel files kept?
auth_glimpse_answer_1: Personnel files are kept for 10 years after the person leaves.
auth_glimpse_answer_2: When that time is up, a disposal committee reviews them.
admin_overview_lead: Accounts, groups and folders at a glance.
admin_attention_mfa: Two-step verification is off for accounts: {count}
admin_audit_ok: The activity log is complete and unchanged: {count} entries checked.
admin_audit_broken: There is a problem with the activity log: {problem}
chat_general_note: This answer does not rest on your documents; it is from general knowledge.
chat_classic_lead: A free conversation, apart from your documents: write, ask, summarise, translate.
chat_classic_scope_hint: The classic chat does not search your documents; answers come from the assistant's general knowledge.
chat_classic_example_mail: Write a short invitation e-mail for tomorrow's meeting
chat_classic_example_plan: List the risks of a new project as bullet points
chat_classic_example_excel: How do I match two Excel tables by a column?
error_classic_chat_disabled: The classic chat is turned off in this installation.
library_empty_add: Drag a file onto the box above to add the first one.
library_empty_read: Documents added to this folder will show up here.
library_uploaded: Files uploaded: {count}. They will be ready in a few minutes.
library_delete_explain: The document is deleted from this folder for everyone and is no longer used in the chat. This cannot be undone.
library_hint_ready: You can ask about them in the chat
library_hint_failed: May need to be uploaded again
library_ocr_note: Reading scanned pages; this can take a while.
system_lead: Whether Synapse's parts are running, documents are being read and backups are taken: all on this page.
system_unavailable: The system status could not be fetched. Check again in a little while.
system_all_good_detail: Every part is running, documents are being read and backups are taken.
system_tell_company: Tell the company that installed Synapse.
system_parts_lead: Synapse is made of a few parts, each doing its own job.
system_part_database_does: Documents, accounts and history are kept here.
system_part_worker_does: Reads uploaded documents and turns scanned pages into text.
system_part_scheduler_does: Clears deleted documents and checks the activity history every night.
system_part_embedding_does: Finds the passages that match what a question means.
system_part_reranking_does: Puts what was found in order, best fit first.
system_part_chat_does: Writes the answer from what was found.
system_issue_database: Synapse cannot work right now. Tell the company that installed it at once.
system_issue_worker: New documents are not being read. If this lasts more than a few minutes, tell the company that installed Synapse.
system_issue_scheduler: Deleted documents are not cleared and the nightly checks do not run. Tell the company that installed Synapse.
system_issue_embedding: Documents can be searched by their words only, not by what they mean. If this lasts more than a few minutes, tell the company that installed Synapse.
system_issue_reranking: What is found cannot be put in order for the question; answers may be a little weaker. If this lasts more than a few minutes, tell the company that installed Synapse.
system_issue_chat: Questions cannot be answered right now; documents can still be searched. If this lasts more than a few minutes, tell the company that installed Synapse.
system_issue_audit_broken: Something in the activity history has been damaged.
system_issue_audit_broken_what: Records may have been changed afterwards. Tell the company that installed Synapse at once.
system_issue_backup_never: No backup has been taken yet.
system_issue_backup_never_what: The company that installed Synapse sets backups up; make sure they did.
system_issue_backup_failed: The last backup could not be taken.
system_issue_backup_failed_what: The last good backup: {when}. If this goes on, tell the company that installed Synapse.
system_issue_backup_old: The last backup was taken {days} days ago.
system_issue_backup_old_what: Backups should be taken every night. Tell the company that installed Synapse.
system_issue_check_failed: The last backup check found a problem.
system_issue_files_missing: The files of some documents cannot be found.
system_issue_files_missing_what: They can be brought back from a backup; tell the company that installed Synapse.
system_issue_retryable_what: You can have them read again with “Try again” under Documents.
system_issue_search_gaps: Some documents cannot be fully searched.
system_issue_purge_late_what: Make sure the caretaker is running; if this goes on, tell the company that installed Synapse.
system_issue_unowned_files: There are files that belong to no document.
system_issue_unowned_files_what: The nightly care should clear them; if this goes on, tell the company that installed Synapse.
system_issue_disk_low_what: Free space: {free}. Delete documents you no longer need, or tell the company that installed Synapse.
system_reason_repository_missing: The backup disk does not seem to be connected.
system_reason_not_configured: Where backups go has not been set.
system_reason_database_down: The records were not running at the time.
system_reason_disk_full: There is no free space left where the backup is written.
system_reason_audit_differs: The activity history differs from the one in the backup; records may have been changed afterwards.
system_reason_rows_differ: Records were missing or extra when the backup was opened.
system_reason_dump_damaged: The backup file turned out to be damaged.
system_documents_lead: Every uploaded document is read first, then made searchable.
system_failed_documents: Documents that could not be read: {count}
system_retry_failed: Could not try again. Try once more in a little while.
system_scanned_lead: Pages that come as pictures are turned into text by the document reader.
system_scanned_uncertain: Pages with a number the reader was unsure of
system_scanned_unread: Pages that could not be read
system_scanned_note: Uncertain numbers are pointed out in answers; when it matters, look at the original document.
system_backups_lead: A backup is taken every night; every three months one is opened to check nothing is missing.
system_space_lead: The room documents and records take, and the free space left.
system_audit_lead: Who did what and when is written in a book nothing can be erased from; every night the caretaker checks it has not been damaged.
chat_scope_lead: Answers come only from the documents where you choose. The choice holds for the next questions in this conversation too.
chat_scope_chosen_detail: Folders, or documents one by one
chat_scope_find: Type a folder or document name
chat_scope_no_match: No folder matches what you typed.
chat_scope_no_folders: There is no folder you can see yet.
chat_scope_note: Choosing a folder chooses the folders inside it too.
chat_scope_too_many: You can choose at most {folders} folders and {documents} documents.
chat_scope_open_folder: Show what is inside the folder
chat_scope_close_folder: Hide what is inside the folder
library_info_found: We found the kind, date and number on the document's first page. Correct them if they are wrong; what you write stays, even when a new version is uploaded.
library_field_kind_help: Pick one from the list or write your own.
library_tags_help: Tags make documents easier to find. At most 20 tags.
error_invalid_metadata: One of the details was not accepted. A tag can have at most 50 letters, and there can be at most 20 tags.
